title: Pennsylvania law allows Turnpike to share vehicle data during missing-persons alerts
summary: A new law creates an exception to Pennsylvania’s tolling data privacy rules, allowing law enforcement to access vehicle movement data during missing-persons investigations.

title: Colorado mobile ID app hacked, app shut down amid investigation
summary: Officials estimate the cybersecurity incident may have impacted between 50,000 and 150,000 individuals' data.

title: ACF launches scorecard to track states’ foster care capacity
summary: The new federal dashboard will track foster home availability, placement stability and other child welfare measures as all 50 states participate in a national initiative.

title: New government leaders urged to prioritize tech talent as AI, modernization reshape public services
summary: To build effective public-sector technology teams, one tech expert says incoming leaders must improve hiring practices and invest in engineering, data and product expertise needed to strengthen government systems.

title: AI is supercharging vulnerability discovery. What that means for state, local governments amid wave of outages
summary: Experts said state and local governments should begin to treat outages as a “new normal” because of increases in vulnerability discoveries.

title: Our elections passed the stress test. Now it’s time to invest
summary: Election officials and partners nationwide rose to the occasion, quickly implementing secure, creative solutions so voters could vote. This was not luck. It was the product of years of preparation in one of the most decentralized and complex operations in American government.

title: New York attorney general creates unit to oversee AI safety and enforcement
summary: The new office will enforce state AI laws, investigate potential harms and help develop policies addressing emerging technology.

title: New York City outlines plan to close digital divide, expand affordable internet
summary: The draft plan features steps to deliver affordable, high-speed internet to more New Yorkers and eliminate digital inequity across the city.

title: Tennessee taps Indiana tech leader Robert Fulk for Secretary of State CIO role
summary: Fulk arrives in Tennessee after leadership roles in Indiana’s Secretary of State office, where he modernized a number of state services using AI.

title: As states move quickly to govern AI, dedicated oversight remains a challenge
summary: New NASCIO survey state AI officers navigating expanding responsibilities as governments work to establish rules for artificial intelligence.
